Probenecid increased the half-life of intravenous lorazepam in 9 healthy subjects.1 Probenecid was considered to impair glucuronide formation selectively and thus the clearance of drugs like lorazepam. Probenecid has also shortened the time to induce anaesthesia with midazolam in 46 patients.2 The effect was considered to be due to competition for plasma protein bind- ing sites.
